1. Any wellsite location that is abandoned must meet the following requirements: 
All excavations and cut and fill slopes are to be returned as closely as possible to original contour, unless 
otherwise authorized by the appropriate agencies. 
Surface Drainage should be diverted around disturbed areas; where this is not possible, unconsolidated 
material must be protected by rip-rap or some other acceptable means. 
All equipment and/or facilities are to be removed from the lease. 
Topsoil is to be spread across lease and the site revegetated, but only after all excavations have settled and 
are level. 
Erosion control measures are to be taken. 
Abandoned locations on Crown land are to have a well identification sign welded to the casing stub.

3. Do not seed any area on private land unless the surface rights landowner consents to the type of seed 
and seeding requirements. Seeding should be done in early spring (after the thaw) or in late fall.

1.  WGSI shall cause the Jedney 2 Project to be designed, located, constructed and operated in 
accordance with the documents listed in Schedule A to this Certificate, collectively comprising 
WGSI’s Application dated October 18, 1996.

3.  WGSI must fulfil all commitments and proposed mitigation measures as. documented in the 
Application dated October 18, 1996, including commitments and measures contained in 
supplementary documents and correspondence listed in Schedule A to this Certificate.

4.  The trucking terminal is approved providing WGSI does not build a trucking terminal as part of 
the proposed WGSI Highway Project.

5.  Despite Condition 1 above, if prior to the granting by the Minister of Employment and Investment 
of “Leave to Open” under the Pipeline Act for the natural gas processing plant and pipelines, 
WGSI requires variation in the Jedney 2 Project design, location, construction or operation 
outlined in the documents in Schedule A to this Certificate: 
a) WGSI shall make application for such variation to authorities required to give 
approvals, licenses, permits or other authorizations under other enactments for 
implementation of the Jedney 2 Project, in accordance with that authority’s approval 
process, unless:
i) the variation would be subject to provisions of the Environmental 
Assessment Reviewable Projects Regulation (B.C. Reg. 276/95) as if the 
Jedney 2 Project was constructed and operational; or
ii) the variation is a modification:
●     to the raw gas pipeline route or the hydrocarbon liquids pipeline route 
and stream crossing locations as documented in Map 4-1, sheets 1 & 
2, in the Application, Appendix D of the Application, correspondence 
dated November 28, 1996 and both letters December 16, 1996 as 
listed in Schedule A to this Certificate, committing WGSI to 
specified routes; 
●     to the number of pipelines, their diameter, or function; 
●     to the location of the gas processing plant outside the proposed new 
plant site boundary as documented in the plot plan in the Application; 
to the disposal of acid gas by a means other than acid gas injection to 
an injection well; 
●     to the location of the acid gas injection wellhead facilities at the 
existing well at b-19-A/94-G-8, unless the modification is an 
alternate well to be drilled within a 50 metre radius of the existing 
well at b-19-A/94-G-8; 
●     to the location of the acid gas pipeline and purge gas pipeline as 
documented in correspondence dated January 17, 1997, as listed in 
Schedule A to this Certificate, unless the acid gas pipeline and purge 
gas pipeline are routed from the plant to an alternate acid gas 
injection well to be drilled within a 50 metre radius of the existing 
well at b-19-A/94-G-8;
●     that involves the construction or installation of facilities on or off the 
main site of the Jedney 2 Project which were not identified in the 
Application as part of the Jedney 2 Project.
b) For the changes listed in Condition 5a) i and ii, WGSI shall:

6. WGSI must, in the reasonable opinion of the Minister, have substantially started and constructed the 
Jedney 2 Project within five years of the issue date of this Certificate.

10. Notwithstanding the preceding Conditions, WGSI must not commence construction on any part of 
the Jedney 2 Project until:
a) The Responsible Minister, or his delegate, has received from WGSI an application, 
under section 116 of the Petroleum and Natural Gas Act (the “PNG Act”), to approve the 
acid gas disposal scheme, or the equivalent of said application including complete 
information as specified in the “Oil and Gas.Handbook”; and
b) The Responsible Minister, or his delegate, has advised the Executive Director in writing 
that he has received and analyzed the application under section 116 of the PNG Act and, 
based on such analysis, the Responsible Minister, or his delegate, has a high degree of 
confidence that the proposed acid gas disposal scheme can be successfully used for acid 
gas injection for the Jedney 2 Project.
